# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
from odoo import models, fields, api

class HotelRoom(models.Model):
    _name = 'hotel.room'
    _description = 'Hotel Room'
    _rec_name = 'name'

    name = fields.Char(
        string='Room Name',
        required=True,
    )
    room_type = fields.Selection(
        selection=[['single', 'Single'], ['double', 'Double'], ['suite', 'Suite']],
        string='Room Type',
        required=True,
    )
    capacity = fields.Integer(
        string='Capacity',
        required=True,
    )

<odoo>
    <data>
        <!-- Tree View for Hotel Reservation -->
        <record id="hotel_reservation_tree_view" model="ir.ui.view">
            <field name="name">hotel.reservation.tree</field>
            <field name="model">hotel.reservation</field>
            <field name="arch" type="xml">
                <tree>
                    <field name="guest_name"/>
                    <field name="room_id"/>
                    <field name="check_in"/>
                    <field name="check_out"/>
                </tree>
            </field>
        </record>

        <!-- Form View for Hotel Reservation -->
        <record id="hotel_reservation_form_view" model="ir.ui.view">
            <field name="name">hotel.reservation.form</field>
            <field name="model">hotel.reservation</field>
            <field name="arch" type="xml">
                <form>
                    <sheet>
                        <group>
                            <field name="guest_name"/>
                            <field name="room_id"/>
                            <field name="check_in"/>
                            <field name="check_out"/>
                        </group>
                    </sheet>
                </form>
            </field>
        </record>

        <!-- Search View for Hotel Reservation -->
        <record id="hotel_reservation_search_view" model="ir.ui.view">
            <field name="name">hotel.reservation.search</field>
            <field name="model">hotel.reservation</field>
            <field name="arch" type="xml">
                <search>
                    <field name="guest_name"/>
                    <field name="room_id"/>
                    <field name="check_in"/>
                    <field name="check_out"/>
                    <separator/>
                    <filter name="today_checkins" string="Today's Check-ins" domain="[('check_in', '>=', datetime.datetime.combine(datetime.date.today(), datetime.time.min)), ('check_in', '<=', datetime.datetime.combine(datetime.date.today(), datetime.time.max))]"/>
                    <filter name="today_checkouts" string="Today's Check-outs" domain="[('check_out', '>=', datetime.datetime.combine(datetime.date.today(), datetime.time.min)), ('check_out', '<=', datetime.datetime.combine(datetime.date.today(), datetime.time.max))]"/>
                    <group expand="0" string="Group By">
                        <filter name="room_id" string="Room" context="{'group_by': 'room_id'}"/>
                    </group>
                </search>
            </field>
        </record>




    </data>
</odoo>
